notes: family: word-trivia-party (batch guess; actual scoring family is end-game-categories with a running VP track). Game ends when the Captain reaches the final story space or a player has all 6 parts alive at end of a lab phase (12 rounds max per search summary; not verified in rulebook text read). Per-part Alive points, dial VP values and bonus-objective availability are printed on components, so they are scorer inputs. Bonus objectives are 10 VP each. Solo mode not modelled.
